scope: Offline identity and coverage audit for ORB-SLAM3 localization-only reference-map runs.
non_claims: Map-supported pose does not imply accurate pose.
Finite system pose does not imply current-frame reference-map support.
Stable map identity does not imply successful relocalization.
This definition is not an event detector or recovery rule.

required_inputs.complete_rgbd_associations: one ordered row per attempted input
required_inputs.input_status_csv: adapter output after each TrackRGBD call
required_inputs.atlas_identity: frozen atlas SHA-256 and initial map ID/keyframe/map-point summary

join_policy.primary_key: ordered input index with strictly increasing RGB timestamp
join_policy.native_frame_id: retained as a separate global ORB frame identity; never assumed to restart at zero after atlas load

conditions: adapter state after TrackRGBD is OK
map ID/keyframes/map points equal the loaded initial summary
MAP_SUPPORTED.meaning: The returned pose was followed by successful current-frame local-map evaluation on the unchanged reference map.

conditions: adapter state after TrackRGBD is OK
VO_FALLBACK.meaning: A finite localization-mode pose exists without current-frame local-map evaluation; it is excluded from map-supported coverage.

conditions: image read failed, input not submitted, finite pose absent, or final tracking state is not OK
INVALID_OR_LOST.meaning: No valid finite system pose for this input.

conditions: required health row is missing/duplicate/misaligned, map identity is unavailable, or fields are invalid
UNKNOWN.meaning: Support identity cannot be decided and is excluded from both supported and fallback counts.

implementation_boundary.tracking_health_local_map_inliers: -1 denotes that TrackLocalMap was not evaluated; nonnegative values are written only when local-map evaluation was attempted.
implementation_boundary.relocalization_indicator: last_relocalization_frame_id equal to current native frame ID may be reported descriptively but is not a pose-accuracy label.

failure_rules.health_log_not_enabled: Run is ineligible for reference-map support coverage.
failure_rules.health_row_count_mismatch: Fail closed and audit the runner/parser before another formal run.
failure_rules.majority_vo_fallback: Retain the result; do not call finite-pose coverage reference-map localization coverage.
